text: Allaahu Toowuɗo On Hino Humpita wonde O Cuɗinanii yimɓe ɓen ka jarribagol ɓe, yiɗugol tuuyooji aduna: wano rewɓe, e ɓiɗɓe worɓe, e jawle heewuɗe tugindiraaɗe, immorde e kaŋŋe e kaalise, e remugol ka leydi; ɗum non ko dakamme nguurndam aduna, hino dakmitoree dumunna refti muta. Haanaa nde gomɗimɗo humondirta e ɗum, Alla, ko ka Makko Kaŋko tun ruttorde moƴƴunde woodi; ko nden woni Aljanna on mo yaajeendi mun fota kammu e leydi.
